# Generated Realm base (linux/amd64)

This relocatable local template retains the exact Realm-owned base recipe,
snapshot lock and canonical inputs. `.devcontainer/devcontainer.json` builds
from this directory; select the same native architecture or explicitly
qualify an emulator separately. The default remote user remains vscode.

`resolved-profile.v1.json` is the canonical resolver output.
`projection.v1.json` binds generator/input/file hashes and limitations.
Source generation proves no image build, registry publication or IDE/cloud
conformance. Task, Python/ShellCheck test tooling and unreleased Mantle are
not installed base capabilities; qualify any explicit overlay separately.
